usage: 焗豬扒飯 is a noun used to refer to a dish consisting of baked pork chop served with rice.
You can use 焗豬扒飯 when ordering food or talking about meal preferences.
This noun is countable, so you can say '一份焗豬扒飯' to mean 'one serving of baked pork chop rice'.
焗豬扒飯 often appears as a menu item in restaurants and cafes.
It can be used in both formal and informal contexts related to dining.
